questions.questionText: A solid wooden cube of side 4 cm is painted red on all six faces and then cut into 64 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 4): exactly two faces painted → 12(n − 2) = 12 × 2 = 24. So the answer is 24.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid iron cube of side 5 cm is painted blue on all six faces and then cut into 125 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 5): exactly one face painted → 6(n − 2)² = 6 × 9 = 54. So the answer is 54.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid sandalwood cube of side 3 cm is painted green on all six faces and then cut into 27 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have no face painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 3): no face painted → (n − 2)³ = 1³ = 1. So the answer is 1.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid soap cube of side 6 cm is painted yellow on all six faces and then cut into 216 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have three faces painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 6): three faces painted → always 8, one at each corner. So the answer is 8.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid cheese cube of side 7 cm is painted black on all six faces and then cut into 343 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 7): exactly two faces painted → 12(n − 2) = 12 × 5 = 60. So the answer is 60.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid ice cube of side 8 cm is painted orange on all six faces and then cut into 512 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 8): exactly one face painted → 6(n − 2)² = 6 × 36 = 216. So the answer is 216.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid marble cube of side 10 cm is painted red on all six faces and then cut into 1000 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have no face painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 10): no face painted → (n − 2)³ = 8³ = 512. So the answer is 512.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid teak-wood cube of side 6 cm is painted blue on all six faces and then cut into 216 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 6): exactly one face painted → 6(n − 2)² = 6 × 16 = 96. So the answer is 96.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A solid clay cube of side 9 cm is painted green on all six faces and then cut into 729 identical small cubes of side 1 cm. How many of the small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: For a cube cut into n³ unit cubes (n = 9): exactly two faces painted → 12(n − 2) = 12 × 7 = 84. So the answer is 84.
questions.shortcut: Corners 8; edge cubes 12(n−2); face-centre cubes 6(n−2)²; interior (n−2)³.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 4 cm is dipped in paint so that all its faces are coloured, and is then sliced into 64 cubes of 1 cm side. How many of the small cubes have at least one coloured face?
questions.explanation: Cubes with no colour form the inner (n − 2)³ = 8 block. At least one coloured face = 64 − 8 = 56.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 5 cm is dipped in paint so that all its faces are coloured, and is then sliced into 125 cubes of 1 cm side. How many of the small cubes have at least one coloured face?
questions.explanation: Cubes with no colour form the inner (n − 2)³ = 27 block. At least one coloured face = 125 − 27 = 98.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 6 cm is dipped in paint so that all its faces are coloured, and is then sliced into 216 cubes of 1 cm side. How many of the small cubes have at least one coloured face?
questions.explanation: Cubes with no colour form the inner (n − 2)³ = 64 block. At least one coloured face = 216 − 64 = 152.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 7 cm is dipped in paint so that all its faces are coloured, and is then sliced into 343 cubes of 1 cm side. How many of the small cubes have at least one coloured face?
questions.explanation: Cubes with no colour form the inner (n − 2)³ = 125 block. At least one coloured face = 343 − 125 = 218.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 10 cm is dipped in paint so that all its faces are coloured, and is then sliced into 1000 cubes of 1 cm side. How many of the small cubes have at least one coloured face?
questions.explanation: Cubes with no colour form the inner (n − 2)³ = 512 block. At least one coloured face = 1000 − 512 = 488.

questions.questionText: A cube of edge 5 cm is painted on every face and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many small cubes have two or more painted faces?
questions.explanation: Three-face cubes = 8 (corners); two-face cubes = 12(n − 2) = 36. Total = 8 + 36 = 44.

questions.questionText: A cube of edge 8 cm is painted on every face and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many small cubes have two or more painted faces?
questions.explanation: Three-face cubes = 8 (corners); two-face cubes = 12(n − 2) = 72. Total = 8 + 72 = 80.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 5 cm has only its top and bottom faces painted green. It is cut into 125 unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: Every cube in the top layer and the bottom layer has exactly one painted face: 2 × 5² = 50.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 6 cm has only its top and bottom faces painted green. It is cut into 216 unit cubes. How many unit cubes have no painted face?
questions.explanation: The 4 middle layers have no painted face: 4 × 6² = 144.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 4 cm has only its top and bottom faces painted green. It is cut into 64 unit cubes. How many unit cubes have two painted faces?
questions.explanation: A unit cube cannot touch both the top and the bottom unless the cube is 1 cm thick, so no cube has two painted faces: answer 0.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 7 cm has only its top and bottom faces painted green. It is cut into 343 unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: Every cube in the top layer and the bottom layer has exactly one painted face: 2 × 7² = 98.

questions.questionText: Two adjacent faces of a cube of side 6 cm (the top face and the front face) are painted red; the other four faces are left unpainted. The cube is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have two painted faces?
questions.explanation: Only the cubes along the common edge touch both painted faces: 6.

questions.questionText: Two adjacent faces of a cube of side 5 cm (the top face and the front face) are painted red; the other four faces are left unpainted. The cube is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: Each painted face has n² = 25 cubes; 5 lie on the common edge. Exactly one face: 2(25 − 5) = 40.

questions.questionText: Two adjacent faces of a cube of side 7 cm (the top face and the front face) are painted red; the other four faces are left unpainted. The cube is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have no painted face?
questions.explanation: Remove the two painted layers: the remaining block is 6 × 6 × 7 = 252 cubes.

questions.questionText: Three faces of a cube of side 5 cm that meet at one corner are painted blue; the other three faces stay unpainted. After cutting it into unit cubes, how many have exactly two painted faces?
questions.explanation: Each of the 3 common edges has 5 cubes, of which the shared corner cube has three painted faces, leaving 4 per edge: 3 × 4 = 12.

questions.questionText: Three faces of a cube of side 6 cm that meet at one corner are painted blue; the other three faces stay unpainted. After cutting it into unit cubes, how many have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: On each painted face, remove the row and column along the shared edges: (6−1)² = 25 cubes. Three faces: 75.

questions.questionText: Three faces of a cube of side 8 cm that meet at one corner are painted blue; the other three faces stay unpainted. After cutting it into unit cubes, how many have no painted face?
questions.explanation: Peel off one layer from each of the three painted faces: (8−1)³ = 343.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 5 cm has its top face painted red, its bottom face painted green and its four side faces painted blue. It is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly two different colours?
questions.explanation: A cube shows red and blue only if it is on the top layer rim: 4(5−1) = 16. Same for green on the bottom rim. Total 32.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 6 cm has its top face painted red, its bottom face painted green and its four side faces painted blue. It is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have only red faces (no other colour)?
questions.explanation: Only the interior of the top face is purely red: (6−2)² = 16.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 7 cm has its top face painted red, its bottom face painted green and its four side faces painted blue. It is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have only blue faces (one or two of them, no red or green)?
questions.explanation: Cubes of the 5 middle layers lying on the vertical faces form a ring of 4(7−1) = 24 cubes per layer: 24 × 5 = 120.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 4 cm has its top face painted red, its bottom face painted green and its four side faces painted blue. It is cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly two blue faces and no other colour?
questions.explanation: These lie on the 4 vertical edges, excluding the top and bottom corners: 4 × (4−2) = 8.

questions.questionText: A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 54 of the small cubes have exactly one painted face, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 96 of the small cubes have exactly one painted face, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 64 of the small cubes have no painted face, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 48 of the small cubes have exactly two painted faces, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 125 of the small cubes have no painted face, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 150 of the small cubes have exactly one painted face, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A solid cube is painted on all faces and then cut into equal small cubes of side 1 cm. If 72 of the small cubes have exactly two painted faces, what was the side of the big cube (in cm)?
A cube of side 6 cm, painted on all faces, is cut into 1 cm cubes. Find the ratio of the number of cubes with exactly one painted face to the number with exactly two painted faces.
questions.explanation: One painted face: 6(6−2)² = 96; two painted faces: 12(6−2) = 48. Ratio = 96 : 48 = 2 : 1.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 10 cm, painted on all faces, is cut into 1 cm cubes. Find the ratio of the number of cubes with exactly one painted face to the number with exactly two painted faces.
questions.explanation: One painted face: 6(10−2)² = 384; two painted faces: 12(10−2) = 96. Ratio = 384 : 96 = 4 : 1.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 8 cm, painted on all faces, is cut into 1 cm cubes. Find the ratio of the number of cubes with exactly one painted face to the number with exactly two painted faces.
questions.explanation: One painted face: 6(8−2)² = 216; two painted faces: 12(8−2) = 72. Ratio = 216 : 72 = 3 : 1.

questions.questionText: A cuboid of dimensions 4 cm × 3 cm × 5 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 60 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have three painted faces?
questions.explanation: Only the 8 corners have three painted faces.

questions.questionText: A cuboid of dimensions 5 cm × 4 cm × 3 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 60 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have exactly two painted faces?
questions.explanation: Two painted faces lie along edges: 4[(5−2)+(4−2)+(3−2)] = 24.

questions.questionText: A cuboid of dimensions 6 cm × 4 cm × 3 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 72 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have exactly one painted face?
A cuboid of dimensions 5 cm × 5 cm × 4 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 100 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have no painted face?
A cuboid of dimensions 8 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 192 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have exactly two painted faces?
questions.explanation: Two painted faces lie along edges: 4[(8−2)+(6−2)+(4−2)] = 48.

questions.questionText: A cuboid of dimensions 10 cm × 5 cm × 4 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 200 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have exactly one painted face?
A cuboid of dimensions 6 cm × 5 cm × 4 cm is painted on all six faces and cut into 120 unit cubes of 1 cm. How many unit cubes have no painted face?
A cube of side 5 cm is painted on five faces — all except the bottom face — and cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: Top face interior: (5−2)² = 9. Each side face, leaving out the two vertical edges and the top row: (5−2)(5−1) = 12, times 4 = 48. Bottom cubes touching a side are not counted separately. Total 57.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 6 cm is painted on five faces — all except the bottom face — and cut into unit cubes. How many unit cubes have no painted face?
questions.explanation: Inner cubes must avoid the top layer and the four side rings but may be in the bottom layer: (6−2) × (6−2) × (6−1) = 80.

questions.questionText: In a painted cube cut into unit cubes, the number of small cubes with exactly two painted faces is 36. How many small cubes have no painted face?
A cube of side 7 cm is painted on all faces and cut into unit cubes. What is the total number of painted unit squares (small faces) visible on all the small cubes together?
questions.explanation: The big cube has 6 faces, each of area 7² = 49 cm², so 6 × 49 = 294 unit painted squares in all, however the cubes are distributed.
questions.shortcut: Painted unit squares = surface area of the original cube.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 12 cm is painted on all faces and cut into cubes of side 3 cm. How many of the smaller cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: Cut count n = 12/3 = 4 per edge. Two-face cubes = 12(n − 2) = 12 × 2 = 24.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 15 cm is painted on all faces and then cut into cubes of side 3 cm. How many of the smaller cubes have no painted face?
questions.explanation: n = 15/3 = 5 per edge. Unpainted = (n − 2)³ = 27.

questions.questionText: A 10 cm cube is painted on all faces and cut into cubes of side 2 cm. How many cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: n = 10/2 = 5. One painted face = 6(n−2)² = 6 × 9 = 54.

questions.questionText: A wooden cube is painted on all faces and cut into 1 cm cubes. If 8 of the small cubes have three painted faces and there are exactly 216 cubes in all, how many small cubes have exactly two painted faces?
questions.explanation: 216 = 6³, so n = 6. Two painted faces = 12(n−2) = 12 × 4 = 48.

questions.questionText: A painted cube is cut into 125 identical small cubes. How many of the small cubes will have exactly three painted faces?
questions.explanation: Whatever the size, only the 8 corner cubes touch three faces of the big cube.

questions.questionText: A cube is painted on all faces and cut into 64 identical small cubes. How many of the small cubes have exactly one painted face?
questions.explanation: 64 = 4³ so n = 4. One painted face = 6(n−2)² = 6 × 4 = 24.
